newsitem.title: USA: Quigley Q1 COLD-EEZE sales exceed $20 mln.
newsitem.headline: Quigley Q1 COLD-EEZE sales exceed $20 mln.

text.p: Quigley Corp, maker of cold relief lozenges, said Wednesday sales of its "COLD EEZE" product rose to more than $20 million during the first quarter ended March 31 from $4.1 million for what it called transitional quarter ended December 31, 1996.
Guy Quigley, president, said preliminary first-quarter results show Quigley has maintained gross profit margins while rapidly boosting production through its manufacturer.
"We are expecting continued strong nationwide demand for the COLD-EEZE product for the 1997/98 cold season and are planning for production and marketing accordingly," he said.
